scope.crypto_prefix: crypto-hist/ (not audited here; separate daily.json files)
scope.rth_window: 09:30-15:55 America/New_York (78 x 5-min slots/day; 16:00 auction bar absent from this dataset)

survivorship_note: The 40 five-minute symbols are today's liquid survivors, NOT a point-in-time universe; symbols that were delisted, acquired, or became illiquid during the sample window are absent, so any cross-sectional backtest on this set is upward-biased by survivorship. The daily set is likewise today's listed universe (~6.5k symbols, not the 1000 stated in data_source_registry.json), so historical daily coverage is also survivorship-biased.

lookahead_risk.split_adjustment: POSSIBLE — extreme >30% single-bar jumps flagged below may reflect unadjusted corporate actions (splits/dividends) that would corrupt per-bar returns unless the series is adjusted.
lookahead_risk.daily_open_field: MOSTLY USABLE — open==close defect is 6.27% weighted / 3.20% median (NOT 64-85%), concentrated in dead/illiquid listings; trustworthy for liquid names. See daily_defect_verdict.
lookahead_risk.daily_close_field: USABLE (open==close defect does not corrupt close).
lookahead_risk.rth_only: 5-min bars are RTH-only (09:30-15:55); overnight/pre/post gaps are not captured, so open gaps are real price gaps, not data gaps.

overall_summary_5min.zero_volume_bars_note: All 30 zero-volume bars are 5 consecutive flat bars (open==high==low==close, barCount==0) on 2026-02-25 10:55-11:15 ET for 6 symbols (ORCL, PG, TMO, UNH, V, XOM). These are no-trade placeholder bars from a transient feed/halt gap, not real zero-volume trading. Rate 30/519709 = 0.0058%.

daily_defect_verdict.claim: Previously stated: daily open field is UNTRUSTED, with open==close for 64-85% of bars (data_source_registry.json).
daily_defect_verdict.finding: NOT REPRODUCED at that magnitude. Current S3 daily data (6551 symbols, 17.39M bars) shows open==close in 6.27% of bars weighted (mean 12.39%, median 3.20% per symbol). Only 385/6551 (5.88%) symbols fall in the 64-85% band, and those are almost entirely illiquid listings (SPAC units/warrants/rights, zero-volume) whose flat bars are genuine (no trades), not open-field corruption.
daily_defect_verdict.implication: The open field is TRUSTWORTHY for liquid names (40-symbol research universe mean open==close = 1.62%). The "open UNTRUSTED 64-85%" flag in data_source_registry.json is OVERSTATED for the current data — likely stale (daily data has since been re-fetched via ibkr_equity_daily_refresh.py) or originally measured on a degenerate subset. Do not blanket-drop the open field; instead exclude illiquid/dead listings by liquidity screens.
daily_defect_verdict.low_price_rounding_note: NVDA is the liquid outlier (22.4% open==close, 34.4% open==prev_close): its 2006-era split-adjusted prices are ~$0.44, where 1-cent rounding makes open==close/prev_close common — a rounding artifact, not corruption.

symbol_count_discrepancy.note: The daily prefix contains 6551 symbol parquets (17.39M bars), not 1000. The registry is stale on universe size. Both figures are survivorship-biased (today's listed universe).
